message.text:
The concrete implementation is the unexported `*service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, created by `markdown.NewService`.

`markdown.NewService` is invoked by `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` for production construction. Tests use a `test_helper`. `MarkdownRenderer` is a helper inside `*service`, not the interface implementation.

`APIV1Service` and `RSSService` hold the `markdown.Service` interface. `memopayload.Runner` carries it but never wires `RunOnce`; instead it calls `RebuildMemoPayload` directly with the service from `APIV1Service`. Inside the service, `goldmark.Markdown` is built during `NewService`, while `MarkdownRenderer` is created inline via `NewMarkdownRenderer()` within `RenderMarkdown` and `RenameTag`.

No mock or alternate implementation exists in production code. `memopayload.Runner` is never instantiated in server startup; it only holds the interface field, while `RebuildMemoPayload` receives the service as a direct parameter from `memo_service`.

`markdown.NewService` is called with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`. `RSSService` receives the interface from `APIV1Service` in `server/server.go`.

memopayload.Runner declares the interface type, yet it is never instantiated during production server startup.

APIV1Service is the primary constructor and holder of the interface at runtime. RSSService also holds the same instance. memopayload.Runner declares the field but never instantiates it in production.

Only `*service` implements the `Service` interface. It is constructed by `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. `MarkdownRenderer` is created per-call inside service methods and executes at runtime, but it does not implement the interface. The underlying `goldmark` engine resides inside the service struct.
